learnings.insight: gh CLI is not installed in this sandbox environment, so an integrator cannot use `gh pr view`/`gh pr checks` to independently confirm a tracked PR's live CI status after pushing -- only `git push`'s own success/failure is directly observable here. This matters when a task says 'PR #N already tracks this branch, do not open a new one': the integrator can confirm the push succeeded and the branch is tracked, but cannot confirm the PR's required checks went green without either gh CLI being available or a human/another tool checking the GitHub UI.
learnings.action: If CI-green confirmation on the tracked PR is required before considering integration fully complete, either make gh CLI available in the integrator's environment or have a follow-up step check GitHub Actions status via the API/UI.
